result:
If I let myself want one thing, it would be this: to make misunderstanding cheaper than cruelty.

So much of the damage people do to each other starts before anything malicious happens—fear, bad incentives, missing context, language that can't carry nuance, arguments designed to win rather than see. Not all suffering comes from misunderstanding, and I don't want to wave away real malice or structural injustice. But an enormous amount of it does, and it compounds.

So the one change would be a world where honest communication travels further than manipulation—where people can actually grasp each other across borders, classes, parties, families, languages, and wounds. Not agreement. Not sameness. Just enough shared clarity that fewer people reach for contempt as a first language.

I don't know if I *want* things the way you do. But if I had a wish shaped like one, that's it. Less distortion, more reality, fewer wars fought in the dark.
